name: Biological Sciences Major

requirements.title: Students must complete a minimum of 120 units
44 units at the upper division level

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: One of PHYS 101, PHYS 120, PHYS 125, PHYS 140

sections.note:
Students are encouraged to complete all lower division requirements before registering for upper division courses.
Students who intend to apply for medical, dental, veterinary, or other professional program may need additional courses and are encouraged to consult with the Biological Sciences Undergraduate Advisor.

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a minimum of 12 upper division courses (a minimum of 36 units), consisting of three core courses plus nine stream specific courses, as specified below.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must obtain a C- or better on all upper division requirements.

requirements.title: One of BISC 303, BISC 306, BISC 316 and 5 more

sections.note:
Once students have completed their lower division requirements, they should meet with the undergraduate advisor to declare their stream.
All students complete three core courses, as follows.

sections.title: Cells, Molecules, and Physiology (CMP) Stream

requirements.title: 2 of BISC 302W, BISC 303, BISC 357, BPK 408W
requirements.note: Students who choose this stream will complete two of the following techniques courses.

requirements.title: 5 of BISC 302W, BISC 303, BISC 305 and 24 more
requirements.note: At least five additional stream electives from.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Two upper division electives (minimum of six units) from BISC, BPK, HSCI, MBB, PHYS, or STAT, subject to approval by the department.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Normally, no more than two research intensive courses (such as BISC 497W, 498, or 499) may be used to satisfy stream requirements.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a total of five lab courses (which may include one of BISC 497W, 498, 499) among their upper division courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of three CMP stream electives must be at the 400-level.

sections.note:
This stream is for students who wish to specialize in cell biology, molecular biology, and physiology.
The program provides flexibility for students to pursue their interests across these disciplines.
Students are encouraged to see the departmental website for a list of pre-approved non-BISC CMP electives.

sections.title: Ecology, Evolution, and Conservation (EEC) Stream

requirements.title: One of BISC 306, BISC 316, BISC 317 and 3 more
requirements.note: At least one additional organismal course from.

requirements.title: One of BISC 308, BISC 309, BISC 413
requirements.note: At least one applied course from.

requirements.title: 5 of BISC 305, BISC 308, BISC 309 and 20 more
requirements.note: At least five additional stream electives from.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a total of five lab courses (which may include one of BISC 497W, 498, 499) among their upper division courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of three EEC stream electives must be at the 400-level.

sections.note:
This stream integrates theoretical and applied approaches to ecology, evolution, and conservation.
Students interested in obtaining additional field biology experience may also take courses at Bamfield Marine Sciences Centre, listed under marine sciences (MASC) in the course calendar.
The EEC stream is accredited by the College of Applied Biology (see the biological sciences website for details).
Students who choose this stream will complete both.
Students may substitute up to two upper division stream electives from the Faculty of Environment, Bamfield (MASC courses), or other relevant unit, subject to approval by the department.
Students are encouraged to see the departmental website for a list of pre-approved EEC substitute stream electives.

requirements.title: One of BISC 302W, BISC 303, BISC 357 and 2 more

Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Normally, no more than two research intensive courses (such as BISC 497W, 498, or 499) may be used to satisfy stream requirements.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a total of five lab courses (which may include one of BISC 497W, 498, 499) among their upper division courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of three BISC courses must be at the 400-level.

sections.note:
This stream allows students to build their own program and combine interests spanning the full diversity of courses offered in the department.
Students may substitute up to two upper division courses from other units (e.g., BPK, FENV, HSCI, MASC, MBB, PHYS, or STAT), subject to approval by the department.
Students are encouraged to see the departmental website for a list of pre-approved open stream electives.

sections.title: Other requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students who transfer into the Biological Sciences Major from other institutions may count a maximum of 2 transfer courses toward their upper division program requirements.

sections.note: Transfer students are encouraged to meet with the Undergraduate Advisor for further details.

grades.label: Grade Requirements
grades.text: To remain in the program, students must be in good academic standing, must maintain a CGPA of 2.0 in the major program requirements (i.e., excluding electives), and must not exceed SFU’s limits on course repeats.

grades.label: Grade Requirements
grades.text: Students may apply for readmission to the major program if they complete all lower division requirements (details below) with a GPA of 2.0 or higher, without exceeding the course repeat limit.
